title: Nonexistence of binary quasi group codes with involutory permutation automorphism group
statement:
Let $C$ be a binary quasi group code of length $n=2m>2$, and let $\operatorname{PAut}(C)$ denote its permutation automorphism group. **Nonexistence conjecture.** There is no binary quasi group code $C$ of length $n=2m>2$ such that

$$
\operatorname{PAut}(C)\cong C_2.
$$

This conjecture generalizes the preceding nonexistence result for lengths $2<n=2m\leq 8$; the authors report that computer calculations suggest it, but a proof would require handling many cases.
